# The ordinary case deserves a record

The printer worked, the rota was full and the new volunteer asked one question before solving a problem. Nothing dramatic happened. Record it briefly so the notebook does not become a catalogue of crises. [[Field methods]]: a collection of memorable failures cannot tell us how often the underlying process usually succeeds.
